parts.text: Money doesn't grow just because you refuse to spend it.
You save every coin. You lock it away. You feel safe.
And everyone calls it the smartest financial decision.
But here's what nobody tells you:
saving money is not the same as building wealth.
A locked piggy bank can only protect what you already have. It can't make it grow.
The people who move ahead spend differently.
Not on things that lose value, but on things that pay them back.
A course that teaches a skill. A book. A tool that saves you hours.
Your best investment is often the one you make in yourself.
But spend on what makes you grow.
